subject: RFI: forensic handoff, retention windows, and export SLA
messages:
From: Alice Zhang <alice.zhang@sentinelbank.com>

Cc: Sentinel Bank Legal <legal@sentinelbank.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RFI: Forensic handoff, retention windows, and export SLA

Hi Mina,

Thanks for taking our call earlier. As part of our procurement security questionnaire we need specifics about how Redwood preserves and delivers audit logs for regulated customers. Can you confirm the following in writing and include any sample artifacts you can share (manifest, hash list, example export):

- Retention windows for audit logs (system events, API requests, admin actions) by default and for enterprise contract (SaaS hosted).
- Mechanism for producing a forensically-sound snapshot (chain-of-custody, timestamping, signing/hash method).
- Typical SLAs and lead times for a bulk export (NDJSON/Parquet) for 30/90/365-day ranges; max payloads and delivery methods (S3 presigned, encrypted tarball, direct transfer).
- Tamper-evidence and verification steps we can run on a sample export.
- Any limitations for PII redaction, deletion windows, or legal-hold overrides.

If possible please attach a redacted sample export manifest and the hash file you would provide to prove integrity. We might need a short call next week to confirm timelines.

Regards,
Alice Zhang
Sr. InfoSec Manager — Sentinel Bank
From: mina_haddad@redwood.ai
To: Alice Zhang <alice.zhang@sentinelbank.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RFI: Forensic handoff, retention windows, and export SLA

Alice —

Thanks for the clear list. I’ve summarized answers below and attached a small redacted sample set plus the integrity manifest. We can follow up with a 30-minute call to walk through verification steps.

Summary (hosted Redwood API / enterprise contract):
- Retention windows: default system logs retained 90 days. Enterprise contracts can extend retention to customizable tiers (1 yr, 3 yrs, custom) via Dedicated/Private offerings — these are set in contract with explicit SLA and storage pricing.
- Forensic snapshot: We support point-in-time exportting of audit logs. Exports are generated as NDJSON with a manifest that includes per-file SHA-256 hashes, a signed timestamp using our audit-signing key (ECDSA P-256), and an export header containing requestor, job id, time range, and sequence. The export job records origin server fingerprints and includes a tamper-evidence bundle (hash-manifest.txt).
- SLA & lead times: standard SLA for export delivery is 7 business days for up to 2 TB (bulk export). For expedited requests (48–72 hours) we offer a premium turnaround (subject to capacity and additional fee). For smaller ranges (<30 days, <100GB) typical turnaround is 48–72 hours. Delivery methods: encrypted S3 presigned URL (AES-256), customer-managed SFTP (optional), or direct transfer to customer VPC endpoint for Private deployments.
- Tamper-evidence verification: use provided SHA-256 manifest and our public signing key (we can provide a verifiable key fingerprint or JWKS endpoint). Steps: compute SHA-256 on each NDJSON shard, compare to manifest, then verify the manifest signature against our public key and timestamp.
- PII redaction / legal hold: we support export-time redaction filters and retention hold flags. Deletions in hosted mode follow the retention window unless an explicit legal hold or Private deployment override is in place; we provide a legal-preservation API for suspension of deletion.

Attachments included (redacted sample):
- export-sample-manifest.ndjson (redacted records, single user anonymized)
- hash-manifest.txt (list of SHA-256 hashes and job header)
- redwood-retention-SOP.pdf (SOP excerpt showing chain-of-custody steps)

Next steps: Ben (cc’d) can provide commercial terms for extended retention and expedited export fees. Karthik can confirm cryptographic details and provide the key fingerprint or JWKS link for verification. If you’d like the sample delivered via secure S3 instead of attached files, we can arrange that.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Head of Trust & Controls — Redwood Inference
redwood.ai | (415) 555-0198
